responsibility: This file implements the function-shape side of the AArch64 SVE ACLE builtin framework: it describes intrinsic prototypes, naming conventions, overload sets, and overload resolution rules independently of the underlying operation semantics. It parses compact type-format descriptions into GCC tree types, applies predication-driven argument rewriting, defines many concrete function_shape classes such as unary, binary, load, store, reduction, lane, and conversion forms, and provides the resolver logic that maps overloaded arm_sve.h calls to specific builtin instances.
same_name_distinction: In the aarch64-sve-builtins-shapes pair, this is the implementation of the shape system itself: it builds prototypes, overloaded names, and resolution logic for each function_shape, whereas aarch64-sve-builtins-shapes.h only declares the catalog of shape objects.
